label: A finite interpretation satisfies the existing separated explanatory Forms…, by Model-construction
meaning: Compose the existing PLATONIC-SELF-PREDICATING-CONSISTENT theorem with the whole/part objection theorem. Keep its two-particular unique-Form separated-causal commitments, interpret all proper-part and spatial allocation predicates as empty, and retain participation. This is a finite countermodel to the necessity of spatial distribution, not an account of why participation explains.
